data.gist: Statistics: mean ± SD in GraphPad Prism; repeated-measures two-way ANOVA for pain over time, one-way ANOVA with Tukey for ≥3 groups, Mann–Whitney for two groups, p<0.05.
data.plain: The authors describe their statistical approach, checking whether data were normally distributed and switching to non-parametric tests when not. Pain measures repeated in the same animals used repeated-measures ANOVA; comparisons of three or more groups used one-way ANOVA with Tukey correction, and two-group comparisons used Mann–Whitney.
